newsitem.title: UK: Brake says results to date much as expected.
newsitem.headline: Brake says results to date much as expected.

text.p: British food supplier Brake Bros Plc said on Wednesday that its results to date are in line with the company's expectations.

Chairman Willian Brake told the annual general meeting that the strengthened management at Puritan Maid -- its multi-temperature distribution business -- is making good progress towards reducing its operating losses.
"Elsewhere, the business is progressing well and results to date are very much in line with our expectations," said Brake, who retires as chairman today to become deputy chairman.
Frank Brake becomes chairman following today's AGM and he will give up his position as chief executive when Ian Player joins the company on July 1 from the Albert Fisher Group Plc.
